memories.content: Source observation (2026-11-05T08:13:48.996Z) from https://ethereum.org/developers/docs/consensus-mechanisms: PoW’s security depends on an attacker having to command enough computing power to outwork the honest network, so mining can consume substantial energy. In either design, participants can earn rewards for helping secure the network.
